description: Extensible LOCAL (bundled) PD/CC cello MusicXML catalog. Bach, Gabrielli, and Dall'Abaco Caprices 1–2 are TEST entries only — not a closed list. Caprice 2 edition comes from IMSLP PDF→Audiveris OMR (engraved Hamrefors). Files ship in-repo; seeing them before --identify does NOT mean a live song ID already ran. MATCH copies/excerpts the edition into outputs/. On miss, --discover can fetch remote PD seeds or PDF+OMR (discovery_index.json). Add pieces with scripts/add_catalog_piece.py / scripts/pdf_to_musicxml.py.
